name: Demo G3: Add-Like Redline Family Instance
description: Exercise an add-like redline operation using a disposable modeled family-instance target: create a bounded device/fixture-like element, prove its requested type, prove it is visible, write a deterministic visual gate, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and non-hosted or level-hosted family type that can be safely placed and deleted.
Prefer a generic annotation, receptacle, light fixture, or other disposable benchmark symbol available in the active model.
success_criteria: A disposable family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested disposable symbol.
The created family instance id is visible in the post-add visible-element inventory.
A deterministic add visual gate artifact passes using post-change capture evidence.
The created family instance is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The family instance is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The post-add visible-element inventory does not contain the created family instance id.
The add visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
The cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the family instance id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task generalizes add-like redline evidence beyond text and tags into actual modeled family instances.
Do not count requestedIds-only cleanup responses as evidence; cleanup must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
